info.title: SportMate API
info.description: Business logic and secure API layer for SportMate. Authentication is handled by Supabase Auth; every protected endpoint expects a Supabase access token in the Authorization header (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`).

get.description: Returns the profile linked to the authenticated Supabase user. Requires a valid Supabase access token in the Authorization header.

patch.description: Updates name and/or avatar for the authenticated user. Role cannot be changed through this endpoint.

get.description: Returns a simple pong response. Requires the ADMIN role. Used to verify RBAC is correctly enforced for admin-only endpoints.

get.summary: Posts with open reports, most reported first

post.summary: Dismiss all open reports on a post

delete.summary: Remove a post as a moderator
